modern: Socrates excused himself to Perdiccas for not going to him, saying: It is because I do not want to perish by the worst of all ends; that is, I do not want to receive a favour and then be unable to return it.
original: Socrates excused himself to Perdiccas for not going to him, saying, It is because I would not perish by the worst of all ends; that is, I would not receive a favor and then be unable to return it.
